quests.title: half six at Canterbury
quests.blurb: This is going to sound small. I start at half six and for a month the Canterbury back lane has had somebody in it who is not waiting for bread. Everyone I have told has looked at me the way you are now. Do not make a scene about it.

steps.label: the lane, from the door, no flash
I am not calling anyone until I am sure

quests.title: The Lane Light, Canterbury
quests.blurb: I have written it down twice and lost it twice. A light on that lane costs Canterbury $35 and the landlord has said no twice, so we are doing it ourselves. This is the third time I have had this conversation. Ask for me by name at the counter.

steps.label: $35 and I will fit it myself
do not tell him where it came from

quests.title: Flour Run, Canterbury
quests.blurb: Do not laugh. The flour for Canterbury comes off a truck at half six and last the Sunday after payday the truck came and the flour did not. It started small, the way these things do. Come back and tell me straight.

steps.label: ride out to Hurlstone Park where the load is made up
the pallet with our name on it, if it exists

quests.title: The Loading Zone, Canterbury
quests.blurb: It is the sort of thing you notice or you do not. The Canterbury loading zone has had a car in it at half six every morning this week and the driver waits in it, which makes it worse. It is the not knowing that has got me, honestly. Do that and we're square.

steps.label: the one who says he is only a minute
and the ticket I got, off him

quests.title: The Sourdough Sign, Canterbury
quests.blurb: Two people have already said no. Somebody two doors down from Canterbury put up a sign on the Sunday after payday that says the same six words as ours, in the same order. There is probably a simple explanation and I would love to hear it. I will owe you one, and I pay those.

steps.label: walk down and read it properly
both signs if you can get them in one frame
tell me I am not imagining it

quests.title: The Old Site, Canterbury
quests.blurb: Someone has to, and it may as well be you. This business was at Hurlstone Park before it was at Canterbury, and there is a woman there who still has the original book. You will see what I mean the second you get there. Do not let them talk you into anything.

steps.label: she is usually about in the afternoon
bring back whatever she is willing to say

quests.title: The Pennant Hills Pool
quests.blurb: This is going to sound small. Council has been saying the Pennant Hills pool is at end of life since grand final week and the crack they keep pointing at is not in the shell. Everyone I have told has looked at me the way you are now. Do not make a scene about it.

steps.label: the crack, close, with something for scale
an engineer can read that. A councillor cannot.

quests.title: The Petition Stall, Pennant Hills
quests.blurb: I have written it down twice and lost it twice. We are running a stall for Pennant Hills on grand final week and a stall needs $33 of gear that nobody has volunteered to pay for. This is the third time I have had this conversation. Ask for me by name at the counter.

steps.label: $33 and a table, if you see one
I will be there from eight either way

quests.title: Squad, Pennant Hills
quests.blurb: Do not laugh. I coach 19 kids at Pennant Hills at half six and three of them have stopped coming without anybody ringing me. It started small, the way these things do. Come back and tell me straight.

steps.label: the flats where two of them live
take something with you, it is a long walk up
I do not need them back. I need to know.

quests.title: The Deep End, Pennant Hills
quests.blurb: It is the sort of thing you notice or you do not. A group has been coming over the Pennant Hills fence after close and swimming in the dark, which is how Pennant Hills loses its pool. It is the not knowing that has got me, honestly. Do that and we're square.

steps.label: the ones who go over the fence
the spot in the fence they use

quests.title: The Kiosk Freezer, Pennant Hills
quests.blurb: Two people have already said no. The kiosk at Pennant Hills has a bucket of odd keys in it and a freezer that has been running warm since grand final week. There is probably a simple explanation and I would love to hear it. I will owe you one, and I pay those.

steps.label: get two, we are going to be here
the plant room behind the kiosk
tell me whether it is the freezer or the power

quests.title: The Aquatic Centre, Pennant Hills
quests.blurb: Someone has to, and it may as well be you. They want everyone from Pennant Hills to drive to the new centre at Beecroft, so somebody should go and see whether it is any good. You will see what I mean the second you get there. Do not let them talk you into anything.

steps.label: have a proper look, not a quick one
be honest with me, even if it is nice

quests.title: The Edmondson Park Rank
quests.blurb: This is going to sound small. The rank outside Edmondson Park used to hold nine cars and since a public holiday nobody remembered it holds four, and nobody will say who moved the line. Everyone I have told has looked at me the way you are now. Do not make a scene about it.

steps.label: the painted line and the old one under it
the old paint is still there, that is the whole argument

quests.title: Lost Fares, Edmondson Park
quests.blurb: I have written it down twice and lost it twice. Since the rank at Edmondson Park shrank I am $43 a week down, and the association wants that number from somebody who can prove it. This is the third time I have had this conversation. Ask for me by name at the counter.

steps.label: $43 in a week, to show it can be done
that is the submission, right there

quests.title: Queue Jumpers, Edmondson Park
quests.blurb: Do not laugh. Cars that have never sat in the Edmondson Park queue turn up at the second express and take the front of it, and the drivers who waited say nothing. It started small, the way these things do. Come back and tell me straight.

steps.label: the ones who take the front
$20, which is about one airport run

quests.title: The Late Train, Edmondson Park
quests.blurb: It is the sort of thing you notice or you do not. When the last train into Edmondson Park is late, 20 people come out at once and I have to have cars there before they do. It is the not knowing that has got me, honestly. Do that and we're square.

steps.label: come in on the last one from Macquarie Fields and see it
the rank at the moment the doors open

quests.title: The Door, Edmondson Park
quests.blurb: Two people have already said no. I have stood on this door near Edmondson Park for 20 years and since a public holiday nobody remembered somebody has been sending my guests to a different rank. There is probably a simple explanation and I would love to hear it. I will owe you one, and I pay those.

steps.label: follow one of them and see where they end up
you will be standing about, get something

quests.title: The Depot, Edmondson Park
quests.blurb: Someone has to, and it may as well be you. The plates working the Edmondson Park rank are dispatched from a depot at Macquarie Fields, and the man who runs it has never met a driver he liked. You will see what I mean the second you get there. Do not let them talk you into anything.

steps.label: go and be pleasant at him anyway
tell me whether he is the problem or the symptom
